title: Mexican coffee cooperative, falling prices (English)
profile_note: Sample producer: coffee, 2nd Grade cooperative, Chiapas, Mexico. Regional facts and coffee price benchmarks exist; the sample has no market-and-price peer projects, so the answer has limited evidence.

turns.text: The price buyers are paying our cooperative for coffee has dropped a lot this year, and our members are worried they won't cover their costs.
It started after last year's harvest. Some members got almost a fifth less per kilo. We tried selling more through the cooperative instead of to local intermediaries.
